definitions.explanation: Having many functions or superior capabilities. Used to describe products, devices, software, or materials that offer advanced features beyond basic models.

examples.japanese: {高機能|こうきのう}なスマートフォンが{欲|ほ}しい。
この{素材|そざい}は{高機能|こうきのう}で{軽量|けいりょう}だ。
examples.english: This material is high-performance and lightweight.

examples.japanese: {高機能|こうきのう}な{家電|かでん}は{便利|べんり}だが、{使|つか}いこなすのに{時間|じかん}がかかることもある。
examples.english: High-tech appliances are convenient, but it can take time to master them.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a prefix or adjective-like modifier with な. Very common in product descriptions, technology reviews, and advertising. Often contrasted with {低機能|ていきのう} (low-function) or {多機能|たきのう} (multi-function).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高機能|こうきのう}{素材|そざい} (high-performance material)
- {高機能|こうきのう}{家電|かでん} (high-tech home appliances)
- {高機能|こうきのう}な{製品|せいひん} (sophisticated product)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多機能|たきのう}: multi-functional — emphasizes having many functions, while {高機能|こうきのう} emphasizes the quality or level of functionality
